services.name: Intro to Jewelry Making
services.desc: Begin by learning to create your own sterling silver band ring with a pre-made setting. Then, build on those skills by creating your own earrings, pendants, or rings. Sterling silver for your first project is included, along with copper and brass. If you choose to make additional silver projects, you will provide your own silver.** All studio supplies included with supply fee. Supply fee includes copper, brass, and sterling silver for your initial project. You will purchase any additional sterling silver that you may use beyond that. services.name: Ceramic Handbuilding
services.desc: This class is ideal for beginner to intermediate wheel-throwing students. Whether you have previous pottery experience or are using the wheel for the first time, you will develop your ceramic skills while creating beautiful, functional pieces. The class covers foundational techniques such as centering, handle making, throwing forms like cups, bowls, and plates, trimming, and surface decoration.
